headline: Trump Issues Final Nuclear Deal Ultimatum to Iran Amid Escalating Regional Tensions
subheadline: Iran's senior advisor Mohsen Rezaei claims US violated Hormuz MoU and vows to target unauthorized warships in response to severe blows.
lede: President Trump declared Iran has a final chance to sign a nuclear deal while revealing a planned attack larger than any since WWII was halted at Iran's request. Iranian advisor Mohsen Rezaei claimed the US violated the Hormuz MoU and inflicted severe blows, vowing to target unauthorized warships. The IDF eliminated PIJ Nukhba commander Mahmoud Fatair, who infiltrated on Oct 7 and held Rom Braslavski captive. Defense Minister Katz retracted his announcement to replace Central Command chief Maj. Gen. Avi Bluth after IDF pushback.

sections.title: Russian Forces Advance in Kharkiv Region
sections.body: Russian forces advanced near Riasne in Kharkiv region and established control over Bely Kolodez and Ustinovka. Ukrainian forces reported destroying Russian UAVs and a locomotive, while Iranian strike plans against Ukraine were reportedly canceled. Six Russian FABs bombed the former Frunze Plant in Sumy, with fighting occurring 13-15 km from northern outskirts. Ukrainian air defense intercepted 27 incoming ballistic missiles with only one Patriot interceptor.

sections.title: IDF Eliminates Senior PIJ Commander, Katz Retracts Order
sections.body: The IDF eliminated PIJ Nukhba commander Mahmoud Fatair in Deir al-Balah; he infiltrated on Oct 7, held Rom Braslavski captive, and appeared in hostage release ceremonies. Defense Minister Katz retracted his announcement to replace Central Command chief Maj. Gen. Avi Bluth after IDF pushback. Hamas affirmed commitment to the ceasefire second phase while awaiting official response from mediator Nikolay Mladenov. Satellite imagery shows damage to Yanbu facilities in Saudi Arabia from recent Houthi attacks.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: The convergence of Trump's 'last chance' ultimatum to Iran, Iran's declared readiness to target unauthorized shipping in Hormuz, and the IDF's targeted killing of a senior PIJ operative creates a multi-axis escalation risk. Iran's claim of having inflicted severe blows on US forces suggests a lowered threshold for direct confrontation. The public discord between Israel's political and military leadership over command appointments adds internal friction during high operational tempo in Gaza and the West Bank.
